title: NVIDIA L40S GPU specs
text: The NVIDIA L40S GPU has 44.7 GiB of VRAM. It is the GPU in the lab's g6e.2xlarge instance.

title: g6e.2xlarge instance specs
text: g6e.2xlarge has 1x NVIDIA L40S GPU (44.7 GiB VRAM), 8 vCPUs, and 64 GiB of system RAM. On-demand price was verified at $2.24/hr in us-east-1 (AWS Price List API, 2026-07-16). No FSx, no EFA, no placement group.

title: Qwen3.6-27B architecture
text: Qwen3.6-27B is a dense 27B-parameter hybrid Gated-DeltaNet + attention model (model_type qwen3_5, architecture Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration). Only 16 of its 64 layers (full_attention_interval=4) use full attention with a token-indexed KV cache; the other 48 layers hold a fixed-size-per-sequence linear-attention recurrent state that scales with concurrency, not context length. It nominally ships a vision tower (image-text-to-text) but this lab serves it text-only via --language-model-only.

title: Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 checkpoint size
text: Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 is Qwen's own published, pre-quantized FP8 checkpoint (fine-grained block-128 FP8, e4m3, dynamic activation scheme) -- not an on-the-fly quantization. Measured weight footprint: 28.75 GiB across the language-model shards, an mtp.safetensors speculative head, and an outside.safetensors with embeddings/vision tower.

title: vLLM tool-calling flags
text: vLLM only emits OpenAI-format tool_calls when launched with --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder. Without both flags the server will not produce tool_calls at all, regardless of what tools are passed in the request.

title: vLLM reasoning / thinking-mode flags
text: vLLM surfaces Qwen3.6's thinking-mode output as a separate reasoning_content field on the response message when launched with --reasoning-parser qwen3. Thinking mode itself is toggled per-request via chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking (true/false); a server-wide default can be set with --default-chat-template-kwargs.

title: Time to First Token (TTFT)
text: TTFT is the time from when a request is submitted to when the first output token is generated. It is exposed by vLLM as the vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds Prometheus metric.

title: Inter-Token Latency (ITL)
text: ITL is the time between generating consecutive output tokens after the first one. It is exposed by vLLM as the vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds Prometheus metric.

title: Turnaround Time (TAT)
text: TAT is the total clock time from user submission to final token delivery, measured at the client/agent layer because it spans the full round trip including any agent reasoning and tool-calling steps, not just raw token generation. This is why the agent itself, not the server, logs TAT.

title: KV cache hit rate
text: KV cache hit rate is computed by dividing vllm:prefix_cache_hits by vllm:prefix_cache_queries. It measures how often prefix caching lets vLLM reuse previously computed KV cache blocks instead of recomputing them.

title: KV-cache management strategy knobs
text: PagedAttention is always on in vLLM. The operator-facing KV-cache management knobs on top of it are prefix caching (--enable-prefix-caching), chunked prefill (--enable-chunked-prefill), and KV cache quantization (--kv-cache-dtype, e.g. fp8_e4m3 to roughly halve KV cache bytes per token).
